name: card
title: Minecraft Card
description: Original Java 26.2 popup panel with native nine-slice tiling, bold ASCII titles, wrapped descriptions and 18/12 logical-pixel spacing. Standard Card section APIs; arbitrary card layouts remain web compositions. 96 native reference cases at scales 1–3.
